explanation: The theorem classifies pairs of subspaces up to unitary equivalence through principal angle sequences (Davis–Kahan/Halmos two-subspace theory). It is built on the library's own definitions: PairOfSubspacesUnitaryEquivalent, angleSequenceDatum, compactAngleEigenvalueList and SameHalmosTrivialDimensions. I grepped Mathlib for UnitaryEquivalent, Halmos and angle-related starProjection results. The only hits were unrelated measure-theory files (Halmos's name appears in measure theory), and I found no two-subspace or principal-angle classification. This does not prove Mathlib has no such result.
